response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.mktnote AS trading_pair, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate IS NULL, total_rebate DESC LIMIT 10
